passage.label: Has reached you story Moses; Lord called sacred valley Tuwa; Go Pharaoh Indeed transgressed; say Would you purify yourself; let me guide you Lord so fear Him; showed him greatest sign; Pharaoh denied disobeyed; turned back striving; gathered people called out; said I am your most exalted lord; Allah seized exemplary punishment last first transgression; Indeed warning whoever would fear Allah

arabicExcerpts.text: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ

mainSubject.label: The story of Moses recalled: his Lord calling him in the sacred valley of Tuwa and sending him to the transgressing Pharaoh with an invitation to purification and guidance toward fearing his Lord; Moses showing the greatest sign yet Pharaoh denying, disobeying, turning back in opposition, gathering his people and declaring himself their most exalted lord; Allah seizing him with exemplary punishment covering both his last and first transgressions as a warning for whoever fears Allah

A warning therein for whoever fears Allah

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the sudden-alertness-after-one-shout statement (14) before the Musa narrative opens (15); P2 ends with the warning-for-the-God-fearing conclusion (26) before the creation-comparison argument begins (27); P3 runs through the heaven-earth-mountain provision catalogue (27-33); P4 covers the Overwhelming Calamity, the two-refuge outcomes, the Hour-timing question and the closing time-compression simile (34-46).
